purpose: Preregistered full Train and full Dev coverage-deficit feature diagnostic; no tracking modification or Test input
unchanged_teacher: Original ByteTrack scores, thresholds and outputs; BirthOnlyTeacher qualification=None
eligible: Actual original unused Step4 opportunities with 0.6<score<0.7
measured: Original teacher current measured proposal assignments, including measured unactivated tracks
deficit: sum confirmed unused confidence / (sum confirmed unused confidence + sum original currently measured confidence), zero for zero denominator
target: After complete sequence inference, known-positive confirmed unused opportunities whose matched valid GT is uncovered by original output local IoU0.5, divided by current valid GT count
Dev_labels: Explicit read-only analysis API; no fitting, Train API bypass or Dev-as-Train label calls
future_selection: A future globally gated tracker requires a separate preregistration, forward internal Train validation gain and full Dev noninferiority before any Test. This diagnostic alone cannot advance Test.
hypothesis: A scene-level need signal may allow weak births in undercovered scenes while preserving already well covered scenes; reject modality claims absent matched evidence
